items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: Our first bass player was Bob Casey... Eddie Condon hired him

ctx.x: But they had an inspiring way of playing that they had worked out because they worked together so long. You know, I had a wonderful rhythm section; we had Gene Schragden on piano, and he's passed away long since.
Our first bass player was Bob Casey, and he had become -- he used to have a drinking problem, and he was on

the wagon trying to make his life, and he couldn't stand being around all the drunks down there, so one of the -- I'll take a pat on the back -- one of my dear, dear friends, I suggested, and Eddie Condon hired him -- was Bigun -- Walter Page.
